title: Authentication
description: Describes an authentication definition associated to a STACKIT Git instance. The provider type will be an openidConnect type.

auto_discover_url.description: The well-known configuration url to use for this authentication definition.

client_id.description: The IDP client id to use.

created_at.description: The date and time the creation of the authentication definition was triggered.

icon_url.description: The url of the icon to use for this authentication definition.

id.description: An auto generated unique uuid which identifies the authentication definition in STACKIT Git instances.

name.description: The name to identify an authentication definition associated with a STACKIT Git instance.

scopes.description: Scopes defines the OIDC scopes to request.

status.description: The current status of the authentication definition.

status_message.description: Provides additional information or error details when the status is 'Error'.
